name: Ultralight Wide Walnut Slats, Brown Felt
summary: Real walnut veneer laminated onto 9mm recycled brown acoustic felt, with no rigid core. Each panel has three 3.82-inch faces separated by 3mm shadow reveals.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: three 97 mm (3.819 in) walnut faces on 100 mm (3.937 in) pitches per 300 mm panel, with 3 mm (0.118 in) wide, 90-degree V reveals cut 1.5 mm into 9 mm brown felt; half-reveals at panel edges form identical joints, and the tile is one panel wide by 24 in tall, with taupe walnut grain and brown felt colors taken from the main listing photo. The 3000 mm (118.11 in) panel is shorter than a full 10 ft wall, and the manufacturer states Wide cannot wrap a column: column texturing is a visualization only, not a supported installation.
